clue.text: Is he the best student of astronomy?

definitions.text: Is he the best student of astronomy?

parts.words: Is he the best student of astronomy?
parts.note: a top pupil might be called a shining light; the question pretends a stargazing pupil is meant

explanation.surface: A teacher wonders who leads the astronomy class.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names the outstanding pupil in a class, the brightest of all.

parts.note: split as two words, the subject of a life written by oneself is oneself, the first person

explanation.surface: Someone describes the topic of the memoir they are writing.
explanation.definitionFit: A subject or topic is the central idea of a piece of writing; read as two words it is the writer.

clue.text: To tear round or just go round

indicators.note: turning the words to tear round means their letters are spun into a new order

explanation.surface: Two ways of moving in a circle: violently or gently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' here is the anagram signal on TO TEAR; the second 'round' is part of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn on an axis is to revolve or spin, going round and round.

parts.note: not a legal officer but the official perched on a tall chair beside a tennis court

explanation.surface: A senior legal figure presiding over a superior court.
explanation.definitionFit: The tennis official sits on a raised chair at the side of the court, ruling on play.

indicators.note: an icon that is shattered is broken into pieces, which are then reassembled differently

parts.note: the word icon is the anagram fodder, which the setter needed to carry one more I

explanation.surface: A smashed religious image reveals a style of building.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram of ICON alone gives only four letters; the setter's fodder is one I short of the five needed.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the classical orders of column design, known by its scroll-shaped capitals.

clue.text: Remarkable bye, say, a type of share

parts.note: in cricket a bye is one example of an extra, a run not scored off the bat
an ordinary share is the common kind of stock in a company

explanation.surface: An investor praises a share purchase as exceptional value.
explanation.walkthrough: The page reads 'buy', but the wordplay needs 'bye': in cricket a bye is a run scored without the bat touching the ball, one of the extras.
explanation.definitionFit: Something remarkable is out of the usual, exceptional or astonishing.

parts.note: a phone book is a volume full of figures, and one Old Testament volume is named for figures

explanation.surface: A tongue-in-cheek idea of a phone book found in scripture.
explanation.definitionFit: The fourth book of the Old Testament takes its name from the census counts it records.

clue.text: It is the view of one who should know better

definitions.text: It is the view of one who should know better

parts.words: It is the view of one who should know better
parts.note: 'know better' sounds like a reproach, but it means knows more than others, as a specialist does

explanation.surface: A rebuke for someone whose opinion ought to have been wiser.
explanation.definitionFit: A specialist's judgement on a question, as given by a professional witness or adviser.

parts.note: to hatch a drawing is to shade it with fine parallel lines
the rear of something is its back

explanation.surface: Someone notes a shaded area at the back of a vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: A type of car with a rear door hinged at the top that opens upward.

indicators.note: a seaplane that has crashed is wrecked, so these letters are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: An aircraft came down on the promenade.
explanation.definitionFit: A promenade is a level paved walk along the shore at a resort.

clue.text: A European for the most part to come to terms

indicators.note: most of the word is kept, its last letter being dropped

parts.note: a Greek is a European, a native of Greece

explanation.surface: A continental negotiator mostly reaches a settlement.
explanation.definitionFit: To reach an accord or settle on the same terms is to concur.

clue.text: Pieces of soap that can be eaten

definitions.meaning: soap is sold in bars, also called tablets
sweet baked goods such as sponges and buns

explanation.definitionFit: Soap comes in bars called by this name, and the same word means sweet baked items.

indicators.note: composition means putting together, so the word verse is made up again in a new order

explanation.surface: Two parts of a poem are set apart.
explanation.definitionFit: To cut apart or split off is to divide.

clue.text: Girl's turned up for some medicine

indicators.note: in a down entry, turned up means the letters read from bottom to top

parts.note: Anne's, with the possessive s, is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl appears seeking a remedy.
explanation.definitionFit: A laxative made from the dried pods or leaves of the cassia plant.

clue.text: Watching serviceman in house the French leave

indicators.note: in places the soldier inside the shortened house
the French words are told to leave the house, so they are removed from it

parts.note: a villa is a house
la is French for the, feminine
GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A soldier is on watch while the French leave the house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leave' tells the French article to quit the house, leaving VIL; 'in' then sets the soldier inside it. 'Watching' works as a noun here: keeping a watch.
explanation.definitionFit: A vigil is a period of keeping awake on watch, so watching as a noun fits.

definitions.meaning: out of practice, as skills are when unused

explanation.surface: Something both coloured like corrosion and past its best.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means coloured like oxidised iron and also out of practice.

parts.note: forcing plants means bringing them on early under cover, here a bell-shaped glass

explanation.surface: Seedlings are pushed beneath something.
explanation.definitionFit: A bell-shaped glass or plastic cover put over young plants to protect them.

parts.note: U stands for upper class

indicators.note: refined fuels are processed, so the letters of fuels are reworked

explanation.surface: Upmarket refined petrol is practical.
explanation.definitionFit: Serviceable means able to do a job, of practical use.

definitions.meaning: a warm mix of wine, hot water, sugar and spice
the title of the Ethiopian emperor

explanation.surface: A warming beverage served to the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: A mulled wine drink, and the title of the former sovereign of Ethiopia.

clue.text: It is thick having only one eye it cannot see through

definitions.text: It is thick having only one eye it cannot see through

parts.words: It is thick having only one eye it cannot see through
parts.note: sounds like a dim one-eyed person, but means a blunt, thick needle whose eye is threaded

explanation.surface: Someone stupid with a single eye cannot see clearly.
explanation.definitionFit: A thick blunt needle with a large eye, used for threading tape or cord.

clue.text: In turn each have the drinks container

indicators.note: In tells us the short form for each goes inside the word turn

explanation.surface: Guests take turns serving drinks from a vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' looks like part of the phrase 'in turn', but it is the container signal; 'have the' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: A large metal vessel with a tap for heating and serving the brew.

parts.note: everybody means all
ay, an old form of yes, affirms like indeed

explanation.surface: Everyone did indeed lay something down.
explanation.definitionFit: To calm or quell fears is to put them down.

indicators.note: becoming means turning into, so the letters turn into another word

explanation.surface: Someone getting thin and flexible.
explanation.definitionFit: Lithe and graceful, bending easily.

clue.text: Edited a paper to be published

indicators.note: a paper that is edited is altered, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A newspaper gets edited before going to print.
explanation.definitionFit: A book is said to come out when it is published.

clue.text: Is able to produce part of a poem

parts.note: can means is able

explanation.surface: Someone capable of writing a section of verse.
explanation.definitionFit: A canto is one of the main divisions of a long poem.

parts.note: alfresco means in the open air, outdoors
a do is a party or celebration

explanation.surface: An open-air banquet to beat all others.
explanation.definitionFit: To exceed or beat someone is to surpass them.

clue.text: Fanatical artilleryman to make an offer

parts.note: RA, the Royal Artillery, stands for a gunner
a bid is an offer

explanation.surface: A zealous gunner bids at auction.
explanation.definitionFit: Rabid means extreme or zealous in one's views.

indicators.note: included shows the letters sit inside the words trip once

explanation.surface: A single journey took in an urban centre.
explanation.walkthrough: RIPON is a cathedral city in North Yorkshire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: A small cathedral city in North Yorkshire.

clue.text: Medal that has gradually been lost over the years

definitions.text: Medal that has gradually been lost over the years

parts.words: Medal that has gradually been lost over the years
parts.note: a medal and order bear this name, and the dominion it names was shed bit by bit in the last century

explanation.surface: Someone mislays a decoration slowly over time.
explanation.walkthrough: The British honours include the Order and Medal of this name, while Britain's colonies gained independence one by one.
explanation.definitionFit: The name of the former worldwide British dominions, also borne by a medal.

parts.note: a corm is a bulb-like underground stem
an ant is an insect

explanation.surface: A list of options: a bird, a bulb, or a bug.
explanation.definitionFit: A large dark diving seabird.
